subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should this PR become the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750, superseding https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083?
rationale: Both PRs introduce durable recovery semantics, but this branch has maintainer-led ownership centralization, race handling, SDK isolation, Doctor behavior, cache-freshness work, and stronger real behavior proof; choosing the permanent persisted-state contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Canonicalize this PR
options.body: Reroot this architecture onto current main, require fresh exact-head proof, merge it, and then close the competing candidate.

options.title: Port into the smaller PR
options.body: Use the narrower candidate only after it adopts the proven atomic ownership, acceptance-boundary, SDK-isolation, reset, and cache-freshness safeguards.

options.title: Redesign the contract
options.body: Pause both PRs if maintainers want different retry counts, tombstone recovery behavior, or persisted ownership semantics.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize this PR
recommendation.body: Reroot this architecture onto current main, require fresh exact-head proof, merge it, and then close the competing candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current architecture and performed the maintainer refresh, giving them the strongest context for selecting and landing the canonical implementation.
